notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed being unable to sell items if the profit were more than your credits balance
[*] Fixed Starkeeper Station (in rooms) having an (unusable) market
[*] Fixed credits counter sometimes saying 0 (when it’s in fact not 0)
[/list]

[list]
[*] Fixed blocks not appearing in the market and some other smaller discrepancies with moving items and buying/selling
[/list]

[list]
[*] Android players will now get mobile notifications for ‘station under attack’ messages. For Steam players it is recommended to also install the Android app to get them, even if you only play on PC. The email notifications have been discontinued
[*] New updates from now on will also give you a notification on Android
[*] Made the debug console way easier to open by no longer requiring the 5 finger tap to happen in the same frame
[*] App download and install size is now substantially smaller
[*] Alpha Central received a small interior remodel in the left wing
[*] 3 new spacelings: Allen (alien), and Chalsey and Kais (human)
[*] Dragging to move items between vehicle and station storage will now move all of them instantly. To move a partial amount, press on the item instead of dragging
[*] Reworked station services UI internally so there may be some additional unspecified changes in behavior
[*] Fixed factions with 50 to 100 members not showing up in the default view all factions list
[*] Fixed challenge mode not loading for new players who have not been in the editor before
[/list]

[list]
[*] Main menu will no longer force link Play Games and Steam on every start if it’s already linked, which previously resulted in unnecessary loading screens
[*] Increased faction max player count from 50 to 100
[*] Closing out of a telescope will now correctly re-open the interaction to use it again without having to walk away first and come back
[*] Minimap now moves along when using the telescope
[*] Camera can now zoom out a bit further
[*] Fixed separators sometimes spawning in already detached as a result of last update
[/list]

[list]
[*] Reworked resegmentation in multiplayer, which should result in more consistent vehicle segments, especially for players with poor internet connections and high ping. This change has also made it so (accidental) segmentation-based lag machines will no longer work as they will only affect the player who spawned them
[*] Multiplayer vehicle position sync is now overall more responsive
[*] Beam and pulse laser range has been increased from 30 to 40m, but both lasers will now gradually start ‘falling off’ and decrease in damage as the beam gets longer
[*] GPS Sensors set to ‘pointer position’ will now use the minimap’s position (where the pointer would be in the game world on the minimap) when you hover over the minimap (from Discord suggestion)
[*] When joining a session, vehicles being spawned in that were already spawned by other players before you joined, will now be smoother and more consistent
[*] In a collision between 2 vehicles, the ‘rammer’ will now receive significantly more damage than 'the rammed’ (from Discord suggestion)
[*] Fuel and items can now be transfered through hinges and pistons (from Discord suggestion)
[*] Various performance improvements related to the vehicle segmentation algorithm
[*] Blocks from other player vehicles that were destroyed before you joined the session will no longer play a destruction animation and play sound effects upon you joining
[*] Kinetic weapon (cannon and rotary cannon) ammo eject animation
[*] If you’re banned it will now also show you the duration next to the end time (from Discord suggestion)
[*] Rotary cannon barrel rotate animation now plays on every (dry) shot, instead of at a fixed interval while holding the fire button
[*] Vehicles will no longer take collision damage (for half a second) when first spawning
[*] Station layouts on the minimap are slightly transparent
[*] Fixed CTL+C and CTRL+V triggering the editor mode keybinds on PC (from Discord suggestion)
[*] Fixed beam and pulse laser range not decreasing after reflecting glass
[/list]

[list]
[*] The starter block amounts will now be loaded in client-side when the server is unavailable, as a (temporary) workaround for ongoing unresolved progress sync issues
[*] Disabled useless warnings generated by some unicode characters not being found in the current font
[*] Added a ‘force sync progress data’ option in the super secret settings
[*] Contacting server’ loading screens related to progress data sync will now contain more details
[/list]

[list]
[*] Reverted back to an older version of ncalc (the function block expression evaluator) as the updated one does not work on a majority of devices
[*] Fixed progress syncing not working resulting in new players sometimes being stuck with no blocks and unable to play
[*] Fixed function block expressions always failing to parse on some device architectures
[*] Fixed function block increased character count to 200 not being adjusted everywhere yet
[*] Function block now displays the correct, updated (newer ncalc version) capitalized function names
[*] Fixed there being a noticeable gap in when the loading screen stops and when the world actually loads in, in multiplayer
[*] Fixed the ‘BGET’ exploit still working when using larger blocks
[/list]

[list]
[*] Code Block: Write custom Lua code to interact with your logic systems
[*] New composite logic node type which consists of an indexed list of boolean and number values combined
[*] Composite Read/Write blocks for adding to and reading out composite data connections to and from code blocks
[*] Redesigned launch panel and added the ability to launch workshop bookmarks (and therefore also in-game bookmarked faction vehicles) directly from it
[*] The 3 major loading screens in the main menu can now be skipped with a ‘continue offline’ button
[*] Made the ‘make sure you have enough rift crystals for the way back' warning popup more obnoxious
[*] Deleting a local vehicle will now also delete the thumbnail file (previously these were left behind)
[*] Increased Function Block expression character limit to 200 characters (from 150) and redesigned its UI to be easier to work on
[*] Updated to the latest version 5.3.1 of NCalc (used in function blocks)
[*] Fixed PC version (which has everything unlocked by default) from also sending unlocked garderobe items to mobile
[*] Fixed Rift Crystal amounts not immediately updating in the vehicle storage UI if the window was left open while rifting
[*] Fixed God Mode not working in some specific scenarios
[*] Fixed settings menu UI not being pixel perfect near the tab edges
[*] Fixed published workshop vehicles having the wrong internal name
[/list]

[list]
[*] Fixed the editor not working for new players
[/list]

[list]
[*] Faction member lists are ordered by member ranks
[*] Tweaked Spaceling drop shadows a bit
[*] Fixed ‘add vehicles’ button in the faction workshop also shown to non-leaders
[*] Fixed load button not showing on workshop vehicles
[*] Fixed saved vehicles not showing immediately when opening the launch panel
[*] Fixed background clipping away when turning very fast with camera sway enabled
[/list]

[list]
[*] Workshop now loads much much faster
[*] Workshop has a greatly decreased data usage
[*] Workshop (UI) has been completely redesigned to be much more usable and convenient
[*] Workshop now shows vehicle descriptions and more details vehicle information in separate windows
[*] New private workshop allows you to save and load vehicles online, to be used only by your account, across multiple devices
[*] Public workshop vehicles can now be bookmarked for convenience, allowing you to save them for later and subscribe to any changes the creator may make later
[*] Public workshop can now be sorted by either most recent uploads or most bookmarked
[*] Reworked load vehicles (UI)
[*] Reworked preset vehicles, now also includes some community tech
[*] Newly saved vehicle thumbnails will now always be pixel-perfect regardless of grid size (does not apply for existing vehicles from older game versions)
[*] Faction roles: There can now be multiple leaders, and there is a new in-between rank of ‘officer’ who can not change faction settings or manage members, but can start sieges
[*] Faction leader(s) can now choose designated vehicles for their members to use, which will show up in a new section of the faction info window
[*] Per-vehicle error handling: A broken vehicle file (for whatever reason) will no longer prevent the others from showing
[*] Added a drop shadow to Spacelings
[*] Removed (annoying) Enter to dock keybind on PC
[*] Pressing Enter will now open chat and highlight the message field on PC
[*] Added support for super ultrawide monitors of 32:9 aspect ratio on PC
[*] Chat bubbles appear closer to the nametag
[*] Most ‘contacting matchmaking services…’ loading screens will now specifically tell you what they’re doing
[*] Redesigned the tutorials panel, they will now always open in YouTube, and added in-game links to AtatataPR’s logic tutorials
[*] Added the new parallax background to the main menu as well
[*] Setting the faction search input field to empty will show all of them again instead of none
[*] Workshop will now block exact duplicate uploads (although only with the same name)
[*] Updated the save, load, workshop, and publish UI to the new dynamically generated UI system, previously only used by the new faction-related stuff
[*] Added a bunch of new loading screen ‘tips’
[*] Fixed new parallax background showing black edges for ultrawide monitors of 21:9 aspect ratio on PC
[*] Fixed preset vehicles being slightly blurry and having distorted colors
[*] Fixed exit camera block button text not fitting inside the button
[/list]

[list]
[*] 5 new star systems including 8 claimable stations
[*] Medium Rift Drive
[*] Finished distance sensor modes and the new tuning config
[*] Siege updates are now also shown in in-game chat across all sectors
[*] Various small UI updates
[*] Simplified siege status nametags, and they now also show outside of the station proximity, in the same sector
[*] Fixed dying in a different sector than where you spawned resulting in a softlock
[*] Fixed distance sensor outputs behaving inconsistent when objects were detected within 0.1m
[*] Fixed mass distance sensor lag
[*] Fixed siege defender launch cooldown showing the wrong amount of time left
[*] Fixed faction UI services requests not showing the load screen
[*] Fixed discrepancy between the buy and sell market UIs
[/list]

[list]
[*] Fixed multiplayer not working for players that were not previously in a faction
[/list]

notes.title: 1.3 The Conquest Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Factions can now claim stations through Conquest play. Attempting to claim an already claimed station will initiate a siege: A timed, ranked 'turfwar' between the attacking and defending faction
[*] You can now get (custom) inputs directly in function blocks by using input(“<input name>”) in the expression. Works both as a boolean and a numerical value (0,1)
[*] Map will now show more information about sectors, the stations within them, and potential factions owning said stations
[*] You can now set the spawn rotation of a Hinge by tuning
[*] Removed the shop’s daily rotation, so all sets and items are now always available
[*] Station and radio TTS announcements will now talk slightly slower
[*] Edited report panel text, fixed a spelling mistake, and added a confirmation for the severe griefing option
[*] Super Secret Settings
[*] Distance Sensor now has multiple checkboxes in tuning for what type of vehicles or objects it will detect. Undetected objects mean the laser go through it, allowing you to now also place the sensor behind other blocks
[*] Drills will no longer trigger haptic feedback when the vehicle storage is full
[*] Colors of star systems are now more realistic, representing real life star types in different lifestages
[*] Various internal reworks for faction-related activities, and UI loading in general
[*] Fixed Starkeeper (room) station not having a minimap icon
[*] Fixed the minimap elements size (for real this time)
[*] Fixed various UI inconsistencies and other small issues
[/list]

[list]
[*] Accumulator logic block
[*] Updated NCalc help link for function blocks
[*] Fixed minimap markers often being the wrong size
[*] Fixed minor discrepancy in incoming Discord chat message styling
[*] Fixed UI error in settings menu
[*] Fixed reflected laser beams sometimes skewing slightly
[*] Fixed rooms not working (via recent server update)
[*] Various other small improvements
[/list]

[list]
[*] Minimap rework: Station interior layouts are now displayed instead of a generic icon
[*] The collision damage formula has been completely reworked to inflict more damage to the vehicle with the higher speed, discouraging low-effort griefing with ‘rammers’
[*] Collision damage will no longer completely hault vehicles, so initially unexposed blocks can now also be damaged if the crash has enough speed
[*] Reports now only include screenshots if the selected reason is not chat-related
[*] Halfed the range after which sound effect volume will start to falloff and eventually no longer be audible for being ‘too far away’
[*] Made station and radio TTS announcements more easily audible with louder clearer voices, and less static/reverb/distortion sound
[*] Slight improvements to the way chat messages are displayed in-game regarding consistency
[*] Increased cut-off character limit for Discord messages in in-game chat
[*] Increased max amount of messages that will fit in-game before older ones are removed
[*] Discord messages in in-game chat now include certain roles if the sender has any
[*] Placed blocks now spawn in the center of the position of placement, where previously wedges and smooth corners would spawn at the pivot
[*] Custom input tab button in-game is now hidden when the current vehicle has no custom inputs
[*] Moved the chat filters server-side to also filter incoming Discord messages and have a larger vocabulary of profanity
[*] Various small UI tweaks
[*] Fixed placing slab wedges causing nearby blocks to be erased
[*] Fixed non-color roles being white instead of the default color
[*] Fixed map and the ability to rift sometimes being available in sandbox
[*] Fixed station and radio announcements sometimes prompting a visible loading screen instead of loading in the background
[*] Fixed radio announcement static not being affected by the sound effects volume setting
[*] Fixed UI alignment error in report panel
[*] Fixed smooth corner 1x4 having an incorrect hotbar icon
[*] Fixed minor discrepancies in the wall colliders of Alpha Central
[/list]

[list]
[*] Paintable glass
[*] Reports now include screenshots of the game world
[*] Station intercom and vehicle radio announcements
[*] Fixed the Orbit Outfitters shop sometimes being empty
[*] Miscellaneous bug fixes
[/list]

[list]
[*] Smart Sensor: Can output a variety of data from the segment it is on for use in logic systems; including items stored, block amounts, chained segment amounts, damage, mass, and total and fraction amounts of hydrogen and battery
[*] Small performance improvement in loading vehicles containing separators
[*] To submit a report you now need to include a description of at least 10 characters
[*] Fixed alternative editor camera controls still overlapping UI
[/list]

[list]
[*] Multiplayer rules in settings
[*] General game server improvements surrounding leaving players
[*]Old (50+ ago) chat messages are removed from the chat panel
[*] Fixed report description panel only accepting alphanumerical characters and having the wrong length limit
[*]Fixed editor alternative camera controls UI overlapping with the custom inputs UI
[/list]

[list]
[*] Report other players for bad behaviour in the Open Play action center
[*] Fixed medium hydrogen tanks having more fuel than supposed to
[/list]

[list]
[*] Added particle effects, sound effects, and haptic feedback to drills
[*] Editor alternative camera controls and a setting to toggle them (Discord suggestion)
[*] Dedicated editor category in settings menu
[*] Fixed separators not separating if there was an unseparated separator on the same segment
[*] Fixed docking in rooms overwriting the current station in open play
[*] Fixed rooms requiring block amounts instead of being the sandbox game mode it should be
[*] Fixed broken styling on the ‘gameplay’ settings menu tab
[/list]

[list]
[*] Desynced player vehicles now spawn at their last known location instead of the world center, previously resulting in vehicles getting stuck inside the station
[*] New editor grid textures
[*] Fixed a mismatch in syncing account data which resulted in having 0 blocks for some players, causing in a softlock
[*] Fixed PC version crashing when opening the shop
[*] Fixed the Large Ion Thruster and Speed Sensor having the wrong icons
[*] Fixed Constant Number block still using floats instead of doubles to parse the tuning input field resulting in rounding errors
[*] Fixed weld groups UI in the editor having the incorrect icons
[*] Fixed the vehicle panel having some blank icons
[*] Fixed the ‘Helmets’ panel in the garderobe being called ‘Spacelings' too
[/list]

[list]
[*] New song (Discord suggestion)
[*] Teal paint color (Discord suggestion)
[*] Rubies premium currency for buying cosmetic items, currently used for Spaceling skins, and a 100 rubies starter amount for all players
[*] The ‘Orbit Outfitters’ have opened shop in Alpha Central
[*] Redesigned garderobe UI and added a preview spaceling in the UI
[*] All numerical logic including function blocks now use doubles instead of floats for increased decimal accuracy (Discord suggestion)
[*] The add-on store’s in-app-purchases now show the localized pricing in the game’s UI instead if you requiring to attempt a purchase to see the price
[*] Garderobe now only shows items which you own
[*] Room’s password input field no longer shows * characters when typing
[*] Digital Display can now display up to 5 decimals instead of 4 (Discord suggestion)
[*] Changed the ‘Chiki’ skin to remove an unintentended reference to a hate symbol
[*] Fixed a few minor issues
[/list]

[list]
[*] Fixed missing icon for the Medium Ion Thruster in the editor hotbar
[*] Fixed small vehicles with thrusters or drills near the edges unable to launch in Conquest
[/list]

notes.title: 1.1 The Logic Update 3
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Custom on-screen inputs of buttons and switches, which can be selected from within the Control Block
[*] Improved multiplayer vehicle sync reliability in spawning and position updates. Position updates should now also look a lot smoother for people with weaker internet connections
[*] Improved Conquest max vehicle size check to be both more accurate and performant
[*] Limit on the amount of Docks that can be launched in Conquest to prevent lagnukers
[*] ‘Push To Toggle’ logic block
[*] Editor hotbar and market listings correctly show block amounts that previously didn’t fit in the textbox, capped to 1 million
[*] Removed the useless ‘delete vehicle’ button from vehicle elements in the station launch list
[*] Some UI changes
[*] Patched lasers being able to fire in between connected blocks
[/list]

[list]
[*] Haptic feedback on weapons fire for Android, and an optional setting to disable it
[*] Info buttons in settings for ‘Haptic feedback’, ‘Camera sway’, and ‘Enable advanced Editor tools’ settings because it might not be immediately obvious what they do
[*] Patched Steam sign in vulnerability allowing naughty people to sign in with your account if they knew you on Steam
[*] Failed Steam sign in attempts will now prompt a retry first before automatically switching to offline mode
[*] Increased chat message character limit from 100 to 200
[*] Separated separator bits now despawn when not attached to anything else, and they have negligible mass and integrity
[*] Changing the sound effects volume in settings now takes effect immediately instead of after a restart
[*] Chat messages at the top will gradually dissapear after 100 have been received
[*] Removed minimum torque clamp for reaction wheel logic input
[*] Inverted reaction wheel logic input turning rotation to match speed and tilt sensor outputs
[*] Added the ‘Enable advanced Editor tools’ switch to the settings menu, ontop of the existing switch in the editor pause menu, because apparently you’re all blind
[*] Fixed reaction wheel spinning CCW from 0 logic input
[/list]

[list]
[*] You can now set a different weld group for each individual attaching part of pistons, hinges, and separators
[*] Separator rework: Each bit will now be separated and stay attached to the corresponding block when activated
[*] Experimental collision damage rework: The new calculation takes into account not only impact velocity, but also mass and angle to be more realistic, prevent exaggerated damage from tiny bits, and falloff ‘scraping’ damage
[*] Added a chromatic aberration effect to the camera block
[*] Fixed being unable to timeout resulting in ‘singleplayer’ multiplayer
[/list]

[list]
[*] Weld Groups: Make blocks in the editor part of different weld groups to prevent them from forming a segment together and get more control over (physics-based) creations
[*] 1x1 blocks now fit into 1x1 gaps
[*] Editor toolbar redesign: By default, it will now only show the most basic tools to make it more newbie-friendly
[*] Dedicated option to re-enable advanced editing tools
[*] PC keybind to toggle welding mode, as usual
[*] Some icons in the editor have been updated for consistency
[*] Fixed logic connections sometimes being visible in vehicle thumbnails
[/list]

notes.title: 1.0 The Conquest Update 1

notes.title: 0.7 The Logic Update 2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] New numerical logic layer: Ontop of the existing ‘boolean’ logic, which exists of inputs and connections being either on or off, the new numerical logic layer can now transfer states in number values between blocks. I.e. a Speed Sensor outputs a number which can be connected to the target angle of a Hinge
[*] Constant On Signal, Delay, Constant Number, Speed Sensor, Threshold Gate, Numerical Switchbox, Memory Register, Numerical Inverter, Abs, Clamp, Function Block, Gauge, Dial, and Digital Display blocks
[*] Target rotation angle numerical input for Hinges
[*] Editor grid can now round blocks positions to half units instead of full units, allowing more control over placement and using blocks that are slab- or quarter-sized
[*] Dragging blocks to place them now correctly detects which blocks it already placed in your ‘drag’ and which it should not overwrite
[*] Reworked saving and loading for block-specific values and node connections
[*] Editor camera will no longer move on accident when you start dragging across the screen close to a logic node, with the intention of just dragging the node
[*] Updated account data sync and added debugging tools for finding issues in production
[/list]

It might be a bit unclear for some logic blocks, which node is which. This is being worked on, but in the meantime you can refer to the image below. More explanation of each block and its inputs and outputs can be found in the in-game descriptions.

notes.title: Droneboi: Conquest launches on Steam!
notes.content:
Droneboi: Conquest is finally launching on Steam!

As promised, this is released as an update to Droneboi 2 to ensure that those who previously purchased Droneboi 2 on Steam, kept access. This is version 0.6.4. Regular changelog relative to previous DB:C builds on Android below:

[list]
[*] Keybinds panel for PC
[*] 8 new keyboard shortcuts in the Editor for PC and mobile users with external input devices
[*] Full-screen setting for PC
[*] Quit button on the main menu for PC
[*] Pressing Enter while typing in chat sends the message on PC
[*] Fixed being able to control spaceling and vehicles accidentally while typing in chat on PC
[*] Fixed music credits not in the correct font
[/list]

[list]
[*] 51x51 vehicles are back in Sandbox
[*] Block descriptions (Hold for 1 second or right-click to open)
[*] Brief Editor manual in both English and Russian
[*] Improved debug console appearance and added stack traces to exceptions
[*] Each segment in addition to the Core segment is shown on the map
[*] Some small UI changes
[*] Fixed gravity not working
[/list]

[list]
[*] Reworked some networking systems, sacrificing some accuracy in favor of stability and performance
[*] Splash screen
[*] 2 new planets
[*] Legend on the Realm planet map
[*] Temporarily disabled wheels in the Realm in Open Play
[*] Hopefully fixed disconnects related to interstitial ads when docking
[*] Fixed gravity sometimes disappearing when in the same session as certain vehicles from other players
[/list]

notes.content:

[*] 23 star systems in the Realm, filled with planets, asteroid belts, stations, and stargates to explore
[*] Jump to other planets within the same star system using an on-board jumpdrive
